acceptance_criteria: The Ops summary continues to derive current healthy, degraded, and offline counts from the latest line-state snapshot rather than historical feed rows.
Every observed health-state transition is durably recorded or directly broadcast at observation time, including transitions that occur between feed reads or concurrent readers.
Feed history and websocket refreshes expose each recorded transition without relying on a request-process global previous-status map.
Focused tests cover current-summary counts, between-read transition cycles, concurrent readers, process restart, and websocket refresh behavior.
blast_radius: Fleet health history and Ops-console summaries for every discovered instance; an incomplete fix can hide real outages or invent stale current-state counts.
evidence_summary: Pinned main contains merged PR #1906: the Ops summary now uses current line state and its focused console coverage passes. The same pinned feed route explicitly retains the accepted #1882 residual: health transitions are synthesized at request time through a process-global previousStatuses baseline, so transitions between reads, process restarts, and concurrent readers can still be lost or raced. A fully paginated 39-open-PR scan found only broad draft path collisions, not an owner for that residual.
falsifier_or_remaining_gap: The surviving claim is falsified only if pinned-main code can be shown to persist or directly broadcast transitions when health is observed, independently of feed requests and process-local state. The focused console tests passed, but fleet feed-route tests were not executed in this record-only lane because they create temporary state; request-time transition durability therefore remains source-proven and requires an isolated mutable test run before implementation completion.
impact: Operators can miss short health cycles and receive incomplete incident history even though the current Ops summary is now accurate.
lead_verification_obligations: Re-read issue #1882 immediately before publication and reject the record if its updated timestamp, title, labels, or body hash changed.
Run isolated feed-route transition tests that permit temporary state and prove between-read cycles, restart recovery, and concurrent-reader behavior before claiming the residual fixed.
Re-scan open pull requests immediately before assigning implementation ownership; PRs #2078, #2500, and #2501 are collision-only drafts, not owners.

partial_findings.summary: Merged PR #1906 changed the Ops summary to current line-state KPIs and added focused regression coverage.
The feed route still synthesizes transitions only when read, using process-global previousStatuses, so intermediate and raced transitions remain lossy.
